svg.title: Kinora — DEPLOYED / ALIBABA CLOUD
svg.desc: Turns a chapter into accepted film shots while preserving continuity. Shot gates measure each render before acceptance. A failed clip never silently becomes a placeholder. Built with QWEN, WAN, PYTHON, ALIBABA CLOUD.
